subject.title: Feature Request: Per-model turn limits with auto-revert

question: Should OpenClaw add a multi-turn model lease contract for `/model --turns N`, and should that contract be slash-command-only, Gateway/API-backed, or deferred until the one-turn override API is settled?
rationale: This changes public model routing, persisted session semantics, warning UX, and config surface; automation should not choose those semantics from implementation convenience.

options.title: Design Lease Contract First
options.body: Adopt a maintainer-owned model lease contract, then implement command/config/session-state behavior with upgrade and auth/provider tests.

options.title: Defer Behind One-Turn API
options.body: Keep this issue open but require the one-turn override contract in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/83565 to settle before layering N-turn leases on top.

options.title: Decline Core Config Surface
options.body: Close or narrow the request if cost governance should stay in operator policy or external tooling rather than OpenClaw session state.

recommendation.title: Design Lease Contract First
recommendation.body: Adopt a maintainer-owned model lease contract, then implement command/config/session-state behavior with upgrade and auth/provider tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is prior work on model override, auth-profile, and session model-selection behavior.
